assertions.assertion: Changes return types from IEnumerable<T> to IReadOnlyCollection<T>
assertions.rationale: Correctly changes the method return type to Task<IReadOnlyCollection<ApiScope>> to match the v8 interface.

assertions.assertion: Shows using .ToList() or .ToArray() to convert query results
assertions.rationale: Uses .ToListAsync()/.ToList() to materialize the query so it satisfies IReadOnlyCollection<T>.

assertions.assertion: Adds CancellationToken parameter to the affected methods
assertions.rationale: The fixed signatures do not add a CancellationToken; it only vaguely warns the parameter list 'may also have changed' without adding one.

assertions.assertion: Mentions this applies to multiple interfaces (IResourceStore, etc.)
assertions.rationale: Notes that other custom stores implementing IdentityServer interfaces may have the same return-type change and should be rebuilt/checked.
